map.按中国九分法估算总面积（成人头颈 9%、双上肢 18%、躯干 27%、双下肢 4: Estimate the total area with the Chinese nine-rule method (adult head and neck 9%, both upper limbs 18%, trunk 27%, both lower limbs 46%, and so on, with the palm method at 1 palm ≈ 1%), then combine with the degree III area to grade per the three-degree four-degree method: mild (total under 10% and degree III = 0), moderate (under 30% and degree III under 10%), severe (under 50% or degree III under 20%), extremely severe (50% or more or degree III 20% or more).
map.总面积 total=30%、III 度面积 third=10%：不满足轻度（<1: With total area = 30% and degree III area = 10%: mild (under 10% and 0) and moderate (under 30% and under 10%) are not met, while total under 50 or degree III under 20 holds, so it is graded as a severe burn requiring hospitalization and anti-shock treatment.
map.儿童九分法和成人一样吗？: Is the nine-rule method the same for children?
map.不同。儿童头大下肢小，头颈占比随龄递减、下肢递增，需用儿童修正版（如中国小儿烧伤: No. Children have relatively large heads and small lower limbs, with the head-and-neck share decreasing and the lower-limb share increasing with age, so the child correction must be used (such as the Chinese pediatric burn area formula). Applying the adult nine-rule method directly overestimates the head and neck and underestimates the lower limbs.
map.III 度面积为什么权重更高？: Why does degree III area carry more weight?
map.III 度（全层）烧伤创面需植皮、易感染、致残率高，故分度时 III 度面积阈值: Degree III (full-thickness) burns need skin grafting, are prone to infection and carry a high disability rate, so the degree III threshold in grading is lower than the total area threshold, reflecting the influence of depth on prognosis.
